question_text: A married woman wants to access reproductive health services, including family planning, at a public health center. The nurse refuses, saying she needs her husband's written consent first. Which provision of RA 10354 (Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Act) is being violated?

options.text: The right to reproductive health care, which requires spousal consent for married women
The right to reproductive health care, which is available to all persons regardless of marital status
The right to information on reproductive health, but not to services without consent
The right to choose a health facility, but not to demand services
